headline: Approved changes to hearing continuance and time-limit rules; tabled revised procedures and rule 14 discussion.
summary: Attorney Donovan reported agreements in three Caesar Drive hearings, with formal agreements to be signed and returned. The hearing for 90 Gridley Street was continued. Nick Palmer was named vice chair.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the September 23, 2026 meeting; all in favor.
Agreement reached in the hearing for 103 Caesar Drive; a formal agreement will be signed and returned.
Agreement reached in the hearing for 105 Caesar Drive; a formal agreement will be signed and returned.
Agreement reached in the hearing for 107 Caesar Drive; a formal agreement will be signed and returned.
Continued the hearing for 90 Gridley Street; all in favor.
Approved amending rule 12.1 to allow one 30-day continuance at the chairman's discretion; all in favor.
Approved amending rules 14.1, 6 and 7 so they are at the commission's discretion; all in favor.
Approved adding a minute to rules 14.1-4 and 14.1-5; all in favor.
Tabled discussion of Rule 14 on non-attorney representation.
Approved rule 15.5 wording on filing not less than two days before the hearing; all in favor.
Appointed Nick Palmer as vice chair; all in favor.
Approved amending rules 14.1-4 and 14.1-5 to add a two-minute limit unless the commission allows more; all in favor.
Approved new rule 9.1 on combining time for consolidated cases; all in favor.
Tabled again the discussion of representation; all in favor.
Tabled the vote on revised commission procedures until the next meeting; all in favor.
Accepted new dates on the 2027 calendar; all in favor.
Accepted the next meeting date of November 18, 2026; all in favor.

decision_evidence.quote: MOTION TO APPROVE the minutes of the September 23, 2026 meeting by Anthony Lozier, Seconded by Nick Palmer. All in favor, none opposed. Motion carries.

a. Jamie Nadeau, Scott Nadeau and Nicole Miller (Tenants) and 103 Caesar Bristol LLC (Landlord) 103 Caesar Drive, Bristol, Connecticut Attorney Donovan reported that an agreement was reached between the parties and a formal agreement will be signed and returned.

b. Rafael Marcial and Vanessa Ramos (Tenants) and 103 Caesar Bristol LLC (Landlord) 105 Caesar Drive, Bristol, Connecticut. Attorney Donovan reported that an agreement was reached between the parties and a formal agreement will be signed and returned.

c. Yomaris Ryan (Tenant) and 103 Caesar Bristol LLC (Landlord) 107 Caesar Drive, Bristol, Connecticut Attorney Donovan reported that an agreement was reached between the parties and a formal agreement will be signed and returned.

d. Joseph and Eric Testman (Tenants) and Marieanne St. Germain (Landlord) 90 Gridley Street, Bristol, Connecticut. MOTION to continue by this hearing by Sue Pyzinski, seconded by Cristina Costa, all in favor, none opposed. Motion carries.

Move to amend 12.1 to provide one 30-day continuance at discretion of chairman. Any further continuance to be voted on by commission after the commission has adjourned and there is a fair vote on the subject. Sue Pyzynski seconded the motion. All in favor. None opposed.
Motion to Amend points 14.1, 6 and 7, be at the discretion of the commission by Anthony Lozier. Nick Palmer seconds motion. Discussion ensued. All in favor, none opposed. Motion Carries.
Kim Ploszaj made a motion to add a minute to 14.1-4 and 14.1-5, Anthony Lozier seconds the motion. All in favor, none opposed. Motion carries.

Motion to open discussion on Rule 14 specific to non attorney representation by Anthony Lozier. Second by Debra Schur. Discussion ensured about the power of attorney from last month’s meeting. Move to table discussion by Anthony Lozier, second by Cristina. Motion carries.
Motion for 15.5 to accept what’s written in brackets regarding not less than two days before the hearing, seconded by Anthony Lozier. All in favor. None opposed. Motion carries.
Motion to Appoint Nick Palmer as vice chair by Debra Schur, seconded by Anthony Lozier. All in favor, none opposed. Motion carries.
Motion to amend 14.1-4 and 14.1-5 to include after 2 minutes in the parentheticals, unless the commission allows more. Nick Palmer seconds. All in favor, motion carries.

Motion to accept the following as 9.1 “In the event the commission consolidates the cases, the common parties time will be aggregated by the number of moving parties” by Anthony Lozier, second by Nick Palmer. All in favor, none opposed.
Motion to retable the discussion of representation by Anthony Lozier, seconded by Nick Palmer. All in favor. None opposed.
Move to table the vote to accept the revised commission procedures for next meeting, by Anthony Lozier, second by Cristina Costa. All in favor, none opposed. Motion carries.
Motion to Accept the New Dates on the 2027 Calendar by Anthony Lozier, seconded by Cristina Costa, all in favor, none opposed, motion carries.
Motion to Accept next month’s meeting by Kim Ploszaj and seconded by Brian Brady. All in favor, none opposed. Motion carries.

Motion to Amend points 14.1, 6 and 7, be at the discretion of the commission by Anthony

Motion to reopen meeting at 7:02 pm by Anthony Lozier.

10.  Adjournment. 
Motion to Adjourn at 7:34 p.m. by Anthony Lozier and seconded by Cristina Costa.  All in favor,
